name: Globe Arcs
description: A dark navy globe made of glowing cyan dots in Three.js, turning slowly in a starfield, with warm amber route arcs that draw themselves between pins and a soft blue atmosphere glow.
style: 3D dotted globe: dark sphere with thousands of cyan land points, near-black navy space with a fixed starfield, amber great-circle route tubes that grow with setDrawRange, glowing pins, amber place chips and a distance counter.
